digest.component_or_area: Jira DC test harness and validation infrastructure
propositions: A vendored Dockerfile builds a local Jira 8.17.1 harness pinned to the addono base image by digest, not by tag, with mandatory entrypoint flags that must survive for cold-start correctness.

The harness must run on a native amd64 runner (not emulated) and binds to loopback-only (127.0.0.1:2990:2990) with TTY and stdin enabled, defaulting to a 20-minute readiness timeout to account for Maven artifact downloads.

Personal Access Token bearer authentication is exercised end-to-end: tokens are minted programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and validated with Authorization: Bearer requests against a real Jira 8.17.1 Server instance.
Teardown verification is index-independent, polling each created issue's direct REST endpoint (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) until it returns 404 rather than relying on search queries.

The harness suite defines _live_jira_ready to participate in the external tier's all-skip canary, failing the session if collected jira_live tests execute zero rather than silently succeeding with nothing.
Jira 8.x is the only supported version on this base; 9+ and 11+ fail Maven resolution; the real-instance validation gap is tracked separately in ticket 9895-ac7d-4276-4f08.
